source: https://www.parlament.hu/web/guest/felicitas/api/query/select/registry/kepviselo-query-provider/kepviselo-lista-idopontban?page=N&size=200 — the query behind parlament.hu's Képviselők list; POST body {"content":{"pCiklus":41,…,"pAktivKepviselo":false,"pDatumField":false,…},"context":{"states":{}}} with the period ignored returns every MP since 1990
note: 1,612 people who sat in the Országgyűlés 1990–2026 as parlament.hu lists them: p_azon (= P4966), name in the API's own spelling (honorifics included), and each faction stint / faction office as a row (not dated here — kepviselo.cgi records carry the dated history). Used to seed the name resolver and to know which records to fetch.
